name: Wirken: binary changed outside wirken update
message:
A Wirken gateway started a binary that is not the release the last `wirken update` on this host installed.

Detection: binary_changed_outside_update (12)
Severity baseline: high

The started version (@wirken.detail.version) differs from the to_version of the host's most recent binary_installed row (@install.to_version), or the binary is not a release build: @wirken.detail.commit unknown, or @wirken.detail.dirty other than clean. binary_installed carries no commit, so the commit is checked for release provenance rather than compared. Pivot on host, @wirken.detail.version, @wirken.detail.commit, @wirken.detail.dirty.

Requires audit schema 2.3.0 and the @install.* pipeline attributes (see datadog/README.md). The 5-minute evaluation delay covers binary_installed reaching the typed feed after the restart that follows it.

@security-team
